originalFullByteInverse.addedJobsBlock:
wave3-native8ac-export:
    if: ${{ inputs.route == 'wave3-native8ac-export' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    concurrency:
      group: pinkha-original-native8ac-export
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, pinkha-scaleway-mac]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0'
      PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.shared_build_plan_sha256 }}
      EXPORT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-native8ac-export-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout only exact read-only export controls
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: control-native8ac-export-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          clean: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/
      - name: Select already installed native ARM64 Python 3.12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          candidates=("$(command -v python3)" "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE:-/nonexistent}"/Python/3.12.*/arm64/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.12/libexec/bin/python3)
          selected=''
          for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
            if [ -x "$candidate" ] && "$candidate" -I -B -c 'import platform,sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,12) and platform.machine() == "arm64"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              selected="$candidate"
              break
            fi
          done
          test -n "$selected"
          dirname "$selected" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Admit the exact original native export plan
        env:
          PINKHA_HOSTED_PLAN: ${{ inputs.shared_build_plan_json }}
        run: |
          python3 -B "control-native8ac-export-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/run.py" inspect \
            --export --control "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/control-native8ac-export-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-native8ac-root-plan-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256"
      - name: Package and independently verify only original native inputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B "control-native8ac-export-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/run.py" export \
            --control "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/control-native8ac-export-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" \
            --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-native8ac-root-plan-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --output "$EXPORT_ROOT" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-native8ac-export-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}.original.log"
      - name: Publish the exact source-bound input archive as an Actions artifact
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Pinkha-Native8ac-Inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.EXPORT_ROOT }}/native8ac-inputs.tar.gz
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Record the actual exported artifact identity
        env:
          ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
          ARTIFACT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-digest }}
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path(os.environ['EXPORT_ROOT']) / 'actions-artifact.json'
          with p.open('x') as f:
              json.dump({'artifactID': os.environ['ARTIFACT_ID'], 'artifactDigest': os.environ['ARTIFACT_DIGEST'],
                         'runID': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'runAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
                         'controlCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'], 'nativeBuildsNow': 0, 'testsExecuted': 0}, f, indent=2)
              f.write('\n')
          PY
      - name: Preserve original input export receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Pinkha-Native8ac-Export-Evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-native8ac-root-plan-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-native8ac-export-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}.original.log
            ${{ env.EXPORT_ROOT }}/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  wave3-hosted-shared-build:
    if: ${{ inputs.route == 'wave3-hosted-shared-build' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: pinkha-original-hosted-shared-build
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 300
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_27.app/Contents/Developer
      GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0'
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.shared_build_plan_sha256 }}
      BUILD_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-hosted-shared-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      RETAIN_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-hosted-shared-retained-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact downstream controls without persistent credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: control
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/
            /Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/combined_heart_semantics/build14/combined_heart_semantics_owned_outcomes.py
            /.github/workflows/pinkha-hosted-shared-build.yml
            /.github/workflows/pinkha-native8ac-export.yml
            /.github/workflows/torah-inspector-ipados27.yml
      - name: Select already installed native ARM64 Python 3.12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          candidates=("$(command -v python3)" "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE:-/nonexistent}"/Python/3.12.*/arm64/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.12/libexec/bin/python3)
          selected=''
          for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
            if [ -x "$candidate" ] && "$candidate" -I -B -c 'import platform,sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,12) and platform.machine() == "arm64"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              selected="$candidate"
              break
            fi
          done
          test -n "$selected"
          dirname "$selected" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Admit the exact root plan before selecting any source
        id: plan
        env:
          PINKHA_HOSTED_PLAN: ${{ inputs.shared_build_plan_json }}
        run: |
          python3 -B control/Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/run.py inspect \
            --control "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/control" --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-root-plan.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256"
      - name: Checkout only the explicitly admitted compiled App source
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.source_sha }}
          path: app/source
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Checkout exact canonical Hanlin source for the original materializer
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: davidpovarsky/hanlin-ai
          ref: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.hanlin_sha }}
          path: hanlin
          persist-credentials: false
          set-safe-directory: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            Packages/HanlinAgentSDK
            Packages/HanlinPlatform
            Packages/HanlinPresentationSDK
            Packages/HanlinMiniAppsBridge
      - name: Build the original App and complete UI once with exact native8ac
        id: build
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B control/Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/run.py execute \
            --control "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/control" --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/app/source" \
            --hanlin "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hanlin" --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-root-plan.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --output "$BUILD_ROOT" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-hosted-execute.original.log"
      - name: Retain original source, complete Products and all original compiler outcomes
        if: ${{ always() && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B control/Tools/PinkhaDualEngineRuntime/hosted_shared_build/retain.py \
            --control "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/control" --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/app/source" \
            --root "$BUILD_ROOT" --output "$RETAIN_ROOT" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/pinkha-hosted-retention.original.log"
      - name: Preserve original build receipts even if complete product archival fails
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Pinkha-Hosted-Shared-Original-Evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-root-plan.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-hosted-execute.original.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pinkha-hosted-retention.original.log
            ${{ env.BUILD_ROOT }}/*.json
            ${{ env.BUILD_ROOT }}/*.log
            ${{ env.BUILD_ROOT }}/toolchain/
            ${{ env.BUILD_ROOT }}/build16/
          retention-days: 30
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Preserve full retained original App and UI products without mode loss
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Pinkha-Hosted-Shared-Original-Products-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.RETAIN_ROOT }}/
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 30
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
